messages:
maya: CI red on master for runtime tests, intermittent failures in TestRetryOrdering and TestSessionGC on linux-x86. 3 failures in the last 6 runs.
liam: ugh, I saw a few flakes earlier too. any obvious error logs?
srini: can someone attach the failing test stderr? trying a local reproduce now.
ci-bot: build: //runtime:unit_tests FAILED (2 tests flaky). Shard: linux-x86-4. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/build/3509/logs
jaim not a person: (ignore)
jen: @maya can you paste the failing stacktrace? the GC one looked like a nil-deref in session finalizer from the last triage I saw.
maya: stack snippet pasted below:
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
goroutine 112 [running]:
redwood/runtime/session.(*Session).finalize(0x0)
    /repo/runtime/session/session.go:214 +0x6b
...
```
mazing: (typo)
liam: hmm that suggests a race where session is closed and finalized concurrently. The retry ordering test might be hitting a timing window.
srini: trying a stress run: `bazel test //runtime:retry_test --runs_per_test=50 --test_arg=--seed=0` locally with race detector off first.
ci-bot: queued rerun: build 3509.1 (rerun for flakes).
alex: note: there was a recent change to retry backoff jitter in PR #8421, maybe correlated. cc @jen since she authored that.
jen: yep I added tiny jitter to avoid thundering-prefetch. I can revert or add stronger nil checks. Which test run shows the jitter correlation?
maya: failures started after that PR merged yesterday afternoon. timestamps line up.
liam: quick triage plan: (1) reproduce locally with seed sweep, (2) run with `-race`, (3) add assert in finalize to no-op if already nil and open a hotfix PR if reproduces.
srini: reproduced locally at seed 2378 with 2/20 failures. attaching minimal repro command: `go test ./runtime -run TestSessionGC -count=20 -run=TestSessionGC -test.seed=2378`
jen: I'll try a small fix: guard finalize with `if s == nil { return }`, push branch `jen/session-finalize-guard` and open PR.
maya: thanks. If jen pushes, can someone trigger a dedicated CI rerun for that branch and land fast if green? :pray:
ci-bot: deploy bot: triggered rerun for jen/session-finalize-guard on linux-x86.
alex: also let's add a short unit test that simulates concurrent Close+Finalize to prevent regressions.
liam: agreed. once jen's PR is up I'll run a bisect across recent commits if flakes persist.
srini: FYI I also saw a retry ordering assertion fail: `expected N attempts before giving up`, seems like backoff jitter changed attempt timing and a test assumed deterministic ordering. I'll update the test to be tolerant to timing jitter.
maya: ok team — plan: jen pushes guard + test update, srini updates the retry test to be less timing strict, then run CI stress. If green after 5 green runs, merge.
jen: working on it now, will ping here when CI passes. :thumbsup:
maya: appreciate it. I'll keep monitoring the CI channel and mark this as triaged.
deploy-bot: note: no production impact, only unit test flakes in CI.
liam: thanks all, standing down until PRs land.
